meetube.description:
MeeTube: a modern YouTube and YouTube Music client in one app, with an aesthetic liquid glass UI. No ads, background play, synced lyrics and 4K downloads, on Android phones and TVs.

YouTube, reimagined. Different by design. Smooth by nature.

A YouTube video and music client, all in one app: MeeTube for videos, and MeeTune, its music side, one tap away.

No ads. No interruptions. Just a gorgeous liquid glass interface, synced lyrics, background playback, and one-tap downloads.

A fresh way to experience YouTube.
